entities.name: Volpaig
entities.description: A crude-minded bishop of the Church of Avacyn who was secretly leader of the Skirsdag Cult, killed by Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed Volpaig seeking Griselbrand.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Demon whose location Volpaig refused to disclose.

entities.name: Mikaeus Cecani
entities.description: Deceased lunarch, the only other person who knew Griselbrand's location.

events.summary: After the loss of Avacyn Volpaig openly promoted the Skirsdag's pro-demon ideology and drew citizens in in Gavony.
events.quote: drawing desperate and disillusioned citizens into the Skirsdag Cult

events.summary: During the Siege of Thraben Liliana killed Volpaig, who refused to reveal Griselbrand's whereabouts.
events.quote: Volpaig's demise came during the Siege of Thraben at the hands of the planeswalker Liliana Vess

events.summary: Volpaig let slip that only the dead Mikaeus Cecani knew; Liliana reanimated Mikaeus and learned Griselbrand was in the Helvault.
events.quote: Liliana used this information to her advantage, ultimately finding and reanimating Mikaeus

relations.note: Killed him during the Siege of Thraben.
relations.quote: Volpaig's demise came during the Siege of Thraben at the hands of the planeswalker Liliana Vess
secretly the leader of the Skirsdag Cult on the plane of Innistrad
Volpaig was a bishop of the Church of Avacyn
